findings.evidence: Approval reuse and scope expansion are authorization attacks.
findings.risk: A valid approval could authorize a different base, plan or diff.
findings.fix: Consume checks task, subset scope, base, plan, diff, role, expiry and one-time state atomically.

corrections: Added durable approval and policy-decision record tables without secret fields.

findings.evidence: Legacy evaluate_paths/evaluate_command callers remain in Phases 0-6.
findings.risk: A breaking replacement would disrupt accepted behavior.
findings.fix: Added deterministic decide while preserving compatibility methods through a documented coexistence path.

findings.evidence: Policy output must distinguish deny from approval required.
findings.risk: Callers could treat a paused action as allowed.
findings.fix: PolicyEffect is an explicit enum and every decision includes reasons, rules, limits, re-evaluation conditions and hash.

corrections: Pydantic forbids malformed approval hashes and times.

findings.evidence: Mandatory platform rules are encoded once in _mandatory_effect.
findings.risk: Duplicated approval tests across adapters could drift.
findings.fix: Adapters consume the decision contract; policy precedence remains centralized.

corrections: Stable hash uses one canonical serializer.

findings.evidence: Expiry, replay, base, plan, diff and scope are distinct contracts.
findings.risk: A single happy-path test would miss approval substitution.
findings.fix: Each invalidation window is independently asserted; migration checks durable uniqueness.

findings.evidence: Approval invalidation claims map directly to ApprovalStore.consume checks.
findings.risk: Undocumented exceptions could encourage unsafe operator assumptions.
findings.fix: Documented scope, role, expiry, replay, base, plan and diff invalidation.
